note: Modern MI DNR campground on no-wake Round Lake in the Irish Hills, in two loops (west and east) with a mix of sunny and shady sites on asphalt pads; the Red and Blue trails run between the loops. Two mini cabins and two tiny houses. The day-use area, buoyed swim beach and general store are on all-sports Wamplers Lake across the street; the Round Lake boating access site is reserved for campers on weekends in the camping season, beside an accessible fishing pier. The DNR says the campground has lots of midweek availability. --Claude
